description: ResolveIT error-code registry. Generated from ErrorCodeRegistry; do not edit by hand. Regenerate: cd backend; .\mvnw.cmd test "-Dtest=ErrorCodeContractTest" "-DupdateContracts=true"

errorCodes.title: Something went wrong on our side
errorCodes.why: ResolveIT couldn't complete the request because of an unexpected error.
errorCodes.nextStep: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact the ResolveIT administrator and quote the reference shown under Details.

errorCodes.title: This action isn't available here
errorCodes.nextStep: Reload the page and try again. If it keeps happening, report it to the ResolveIT administrator.

errorCodes.title: This request can't be processed
errorCodes.why: The request to {path} uses a format or option that ResolveIT doesn't support.
errorCodes.nextStep: Reload the page and try again. If it keeps happening, report it to the ResolveIT administrator.

errorCodes.title: This page or item doesn't exist
errorCodes.why: Nothing is available at {path}. The link may be outdated or mistyped.
errorCodes.nextStep: Check the address, or go back to the dashboard and open the item from there.

errorCodes.title: Some information is missing or invalid
errorCodes.why: The request could not be accepted because these fields are missing or invalid: {fields}.
errorCodes.nextStep: Correct the highlighted fields and submit again.
